evidence: Sort by Priority ordered tasks High(x4), Medium(x2), Low(x1) correctly.
Sort by Deadline ordered ascending Aug25..Sep15, and task with no deadline (Water the plants) appeared after all dated tasks.

issue: Edit action fully disabled for blocked tasks instead of allowing partial edit
actual: For a blocked task (e.g. "Complete tax filing"), the edit (pencil) button is fully disabled (DOM disabled=true), so the edit dialog cannot be opened at all. Users cannot change description or priority as required; the entire edit action is unavailable, not just title/deadline.

evidence: Created "Plan birthday party"; active count increased 5->6, task retained in active list.

Task created with title, description, deadline, High priority and prerequisite "Buy groceries"; all details retained and displayed. Second task created with only title (no desc/deadline) - optional fields correctly omitted from display.

Edited "Review project proposal" -> title, description, deadline, priority, and added prerequisite "Buy groceries"; all changes saved and displayed correctly (dependent task's warning label updated to new title too). Deleted "Water the plants"; it was removed from list and active count decreased.
Completed "Buy groceries": left active list, appeared in Completed view, active count 6->5, completed count 2->3.
Active/Completed tabs show only tasks of that state with correct counts (e.g. "Active 5"/"Completed 3" matching displayed items).

Assigned "Buy groceries" as prerequisite when creating "Plan birthday party" and added "Buy groceries" as prerequisite when editing "Review project proposal"; both tasks correctly showed blocked/dependency state referencing the prerequisite.

Blocked tasks rendered with dashed warning-colored border (bg-muted/30 border-dashed border-warning/40) vs normal cards, and complete toggle button is disabled (DOM disabled=true) until prerequisites complete.
Single incomplete prerequisite shown as: Prerequisite "X" incomplete. Multiple (2) incomplete prerequisites shown as: "2 prerequisites incomplete".
Complete toggle button disabled (DOM disabled=true) on blocked tasks; became enabled once prerequisite "Buy groceries" was completed. Verified across multiple tasks.

Edit dialog for "Review project proposal v2" (which has dependents "Complete tax filing" and indirectly "Submit final report") excluded both from the selectable prerequisite checkbox list, preventing a circular dependency.
Entering whitespace-only text "   " into Title field left "Create Task" button disabled, preventing submission; active/completed counts unchanged.
Completed "Buy groceries" remained visible in Completed view (not deleted); reopening it via toggle moved it back to Active view successfully.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves a completed dependent task in an invalid completed+blocked state
actual: Completed "Buy groceries", then completed dependent "Review project proposal v2" (prerequisite satisfied). Reopened "Buy groceries" again (allowed without restriction). "Review project proposal v2" remained in the Completed view/count (still counted as completed) but simultaneously displayed "Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete" warning and its reopen toggle became disabled. The system neither prevented the prerequisite reopening nor reverted the dependent task to an incomplete state, leaving it simultaneously completed and blocked.

issue: Unable to trigger dependency-chain popup by hovering the visual connector line
actual: Dashed SVG connector lines exist between dependent tasks (data-state="closed" attribute suggesting an intended tooltip trigger). However, the connector paths render with zero geometric width (pure vertical lines), making them non-actionable via standard hover interaction. Realistic hover attempts—including dispatching pointerover/pointerenter/mouseover/mouseenter events on the exact DOM node returned by elementFromPoint at the line's rendered screen coordinates—did not open a tooltip or change data-state from "closed", unlike the equivalent prerequisite-warning hover (IX-20) which worked correctly via the same class of interaction.

evidence: Hovering over the "Prerequisite ... incomplete" warning on "Submit final report" displayed a "Dependency Chain" tooltip listing the chain (Review project proposal v2 -> Buy groceries [pending] -> Complete tax filing [pending]) with pending status for each incomplete prerequisite.

Tasks display title and priority always; description and deadline shown only when supplied (verified with "Water the plants" lacking both); blocking prerequisite warning shown when applicable; completed tasks styled with line-through text and muted background (bg-muted/50) vs active cards (bg-card), clearly visually distinguished.
